title: Christmas Rose Cottage Pattern Paper
author: Altered Art Designz
description:
Celebrate the season with the timeless beauty of the Christmas Rose Cottage Collection, a luxurious set of 10 seamless digital papers inspired by elegant Victorian Christmas celebrations, romantic English cottage gardens, and antique French stationery.
Unlike traditional Christmas papers, this collection embraces a soft, feminine palette of dusty blush roses, antique pinks, pearl ivory, muted sage, eucalyptus, winter greenery, delicate holly, cedar, pine, and subtle champagne-gold accents, creating a sophisticated holiday aesthetic perfect for both crafting and home décor.
Each seamless design has been carefully painted in a premium watercolor style and professionally created to repeat beautifully, making these papers ideal for large-format printing, wrapping paper, stationery, fabric-inspired projects, scrap-booking, card making, journals, planners, gift tags, invitations, digital backgrounds, home décor, and print-on-demand applications.
Every paper was designed as part of one cohesive collection, allowing you to mix and match patterns effortlessly across all your creative projects.
Whether you’re creating handmade Christmas gifts, designing seasonal stationery, decorating journals, or crafting beautiful keepsakes, Christmas Rose Cottage offers an elegant alternative to traditional holiday papers with its romantic vintage charm and collectible heirloom aesthetic.
What’s Included
🎄 10 Seamless Digital Papers
📏 12 × 12 inches
🖨️ 300 DPI
📁 JPEG Format
♾️ Perfect Seamless Repeat
💻 Digital Download
🚫 No physical product will be shipped
